must_identify.item: The api Service targetPort is 9090 while the api container listens on 8080, so connections from the frontend are refused (502)
must_identify.evidence: Confirmed root cause: a patch to the api Service in shop changed targetPort from 8080 to 9090, while the api pods (api-f64486c4c-58rpc, api-f64486c4c-zfk76) still listen on 8080 only.

must_identify.item: The worker's warnings and errors are not the cause of the frontend 5xx

notes: The root cause and fix are correct and well evidenced. The RCA never mentions the worker or its noisy logs, so it never explicitly rules them out. The command list shows no worker logs were fetched, so the investigator likely never engaged with the distractor.
